description: Unofficial fan-art animated companion inspired by Doraemon. The earless round blue robot cat enjoys dorayaki, displays a bamboo-copter, inspects a palm-sized pink Anywhere Door, searches his pocket for harmless gadgets, waits, jumps and runs with alternating short white feet in three views. The miniature door and gadget choreography are original desktop-companion adaptations. Independently drawn; not endorsed by the rights holder.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
